.ap-rating { min-width: 185px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ap-line); border-radius: 16px; background: #f7f9fc; }
.ap-rating > span { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: #718097; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ap-review { padding: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--ap-line); border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; }
.ap-review p { min-height: 115px; margin: 18px 0 22px; color: #34425a !important; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }
.ap-review > span { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: #8390a2 !important; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ap-final p { max-width: 620px; margin: 15px 0 0; color: #c2d4e9 !important; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
